subject: GCP co-sell evidence scrub & brand/claims SLA asks
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 02 Jun 2028 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: GCP co-sell evidence scrub & brand/claims SLA asks

Team —

We have our first GCP co-sell intake for Big Retail (DEAL-57821). GCP’s listing team ran a preliminary pass and flagged three areas we need to tidy before we request publication: branding/asset usage, product claims language, and the support SLA mapping for co-sell routing.

I uploaded a working checklist and the items GCP called out to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BzGCPEvidence/12345 — please review. Key asks below: 

- Branding: confirm logos, product naming, and approved marketing blurbs (GCP wants explicit, short-form copy).
- Claims: any throughput/latency cost claims must be evidence-backed and framed as observed in our incumbency tests; GCP flagged "predictable latency" as vague.
- Support SLA mapping: GCP requires us to map our Redwood support tiers to their Marketplace support windows and identify escalation path for co-sell customers.

Attachments: [Attachment: gcp_evidence_checklist_2028.xlsx (xlsx)]

Asks (owners):
- Branding + copy scrub: Marissa (please include marketing legal pointers)
- Claims evidence + wording: Alex (include quant/benchmark references and citations)
- Support window matrix & escalation flow: Markus + Ben (map our Dedicated/Private options to GCP routing)

Timing: GCP expects a consolidated packet by EOD Monday (6/5). If we can’t meet full packet, prioritize a clean brand/claims slate and a provisional SLA mapping so GCP can unblock listing QA.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the final assembly and feed to Emily Hoffman at GCP.

Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: gcp_evidence_checklist_2028.xlsx]

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell evidence scrub & brand/claims SLA asks

Irene — thanks for the heads up. Quick clarifying notes from the bench: 

- For the "predictable latency" claim GCP flagged: I can supply a 30-day P95/P99 summary for the model variants we intend to list, plus the test harness config (inference batch sizes, seq length distribution). Suggest we reword to: "Observed median latency of Xms and P95 of Yms under typical 8k token workloads (see benchmark appendix)." That keeps it concrete.

- I'll attach the benchmark CSV and a short blurb we can use for the listing. If legal wants softer language, we can provide "typical observed" rather than absolute guarantees.

Attachment: [Attachment: inference_latency_summary_30d.csv (csv)]

Action: I’ll drop files into the Drive and paste final suggested copy into the checklist by EOD today.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Principal Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: inference_latency_summary_30d.csv]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell evidence scrub & brand/claims SLA asks

Quick update from marketing/legal side:

- I attached our latest brand guidelines and a short approved product description set (we should use the short-form 150-char tagline + 300-char description — those are vetted).
- GCP requires logo files in SVG + PNG (color and mono). I ran a quick check: the Drive folder includes PNGs but I’m uploading SVGs now.
- For claims: Legal insists we avoid direct uptime/availability % in listing copy unless backed by our Dedicated SLA (we can include historical uptime in the evidence packet but not in the public blurb).

Attachment: [Attachment: brand_guidelines_v3.pdf (pdf)]

Proposed short blurb for listing (150 chars): "Low-latency LLM inference with flexible deployment: hosted API, reserved Dedicated pools, and private VPC options."

Irene — I’ll mark up the checklist with the exact file names and add the SVGs. Let me know if you want me to push alternative softened claim language for Alex to review.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Growth Marketing, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Jun 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell evidence scrub & brand/claims SLA asks

Tagging on support mapping:

- I started a support-window matrix and attached it for review. We need to map Redwood tiers (Self-serve / Standard / Enterprise) to GCP Marketplace support levels and indicate when GCP will route via their support vs. our CS. For co-sell accounts, GCP typically requires a named escalation path to an AE or CS SME.
- Question for contracts: do we need a short MRA addendum to be included in the marketplace listing (some partners include a one-paragraph "co-sell support" note). If so, we should loop Legal + Contracts.

Attachment: [Attachment: support-window-matrix.csv (csv)]

I can take draft ownership of the escalation flow diagram if Ben and I can sync for 30m tomorrow.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Hoffman <emily.hoffman@gcp-partner.com>, contracts@bigretail.com (Big Retail Inc.)
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, GCP Marketplace Support <marketplace-support@gcp.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jun 2028 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: GCP co-sell evidence scrub & brand/claims SLA asks — sync and questions

Emily / GCP team —

Looping you in. We’re assembling the packet for Big Retail (DEAL-57821). Internal deadline to hand GCP a tidy packet is EOD today; we’ll follow with any outstanding artifacts early tomorrow. Two quick questions we want to confirm with you so the QA pass doesn’t get bounced: 

1) Branding: GCP asked we supply a 150-char short blurb plus 300-char description and logos in SVG. Confirmed?
2) Support SLA mapping: for co-sell customers routed through GCP, do you need a signed MRA-style addendum included in the listing, or is a documented escalation path + point of contact sufficient for publication?

We’ve attached the checklist + evidence and put files in the Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BzGCPEvidence/12345. Key attachments: gcp_evidence_checklist_2028.xlsx, brand_guidelines_v3.pdf, support-window-matrix.csv.

Emily — can we schedule a 30-min call this afternoon or tomorrow morning to walk the packet and make sure no surprises pop in QA? I’m available 3–5pm PT today or 9–11am PT tomorrow.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out quickly.

Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
[Attachments: gcp_evidence_checklist_2028.xlsx, brand_guidelines_v3.pdf, support-window-matrix.csv]
